intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Nerelle rests her chin on her folded arms at the water’s edge and looks across at the far bank.

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “From down here, I can see under every bridge in the kingdom. Someone has carved initials into most of them.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Several have been crossed out. Surface romance is very well documented from below.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “I can see the rooftops from up here. There’s a cat on one.”

options.labelText: “Trade? Your bridges for my rooftops, every time we meet.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Agreed. I would like that very much.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “I will begin with the initials. You may want to sit down.”

options.labelText: “Honestly, the view’s better up here. I can describe it all for you.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Wonderful. Describe the initials under the bridge.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: You cannot. She does not tell you what they say.
